checks.name: test
checks.command: cd SystemCode && uv run --package remy-api pytest -q remy/api/tests/features/plan && uv run --package remy-workflows pytest -q remy/workflows/tests && uv run --package remy-app pytest -q remy/app/tests

checks.name: lint
checks.command: cd SystemCode && uv run --package remy-workflows ruff check remy/workflows/src remy/workflows/tests --select F,E9 && uv run --package remy-app ruff check remy/app/src remy/app/tests --select F,E9

checks.name: typecheck
checks.command: cd SystemCode && uv run --package remy-workflows mypy remy/workflows/src --ignore-missing-imports && uv run --package remy-app mypy remy/app/src --ignore-missing-imports
